brief: First array entry that passes a test
description: Call predicate for each entry of the first array in values, in index order, until it returns true, then return that entry. Entries whose value is undefined are included. If no entry passes, the result is undefined (the same as a found undefined entry; use filter if you need to tell those apart).

parameters.description: This is a boolean function that is called to determine if an array entry passes the test.
parameters.name: predicate

parameters.description: These are the values passed to the predicate with the exception that the first array is passed as the single current value from the array. At least one array is required.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The first matching entry, or undefined if none match.
